exposure: selective chemoembolization with methotrexate (SCEM) followed by suction curettage (SC)
cohort: 22 patients diagnosed with caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated with SCEM followed by SC between 2015 and 2018
finding: SCEM followed by SC is an effective treatment for CSP with a 91% success rate, but long-term complications such as hypomenorrhea, amenorrhea, and Asherman syndrome were observed, impacting future fertility.
